rationale: Second scenario for the same protection, closing the limitation that the first check stopped at the propose channel: this harness carries the re-proposed operation through the normal PreAccept and commit rounds with a peer via the real codec, commits the new instance at both replicas, applies it with the real executor and observes the client's reply. The local construction run shows pending 1 before the commit, a re-proposal on the channel after it, the new instance committed at both replicas, and execution writing 17 bytes to the client's writer (replied true) - so the operation survives a NOOP recovery end to end. The obligation, plan predicates and binding are the reviewed ones; the trusted runner and a fresh correspondence review decide the formal outcome.
